description: A company's 10-K/10-Q/20-F/40-F filings (newest accepted first, up to 40) with revenue, profit, EPS, cash, debt, cash flow and margins as each filing first reported them, EDGAR acceptance time and filing link. as_of = only filings accepted by then.

as_of.description: Point in time: only filings EDGAR had accepted by then. YYYY-MM-DD (end of day, New York) or ISO time with offset. Empty = now

cik.description: SEC CIK number, for companies without a listed ticker

fields.description: Only these metrics (comma separated): revenue, cost_of_revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_basic, eps_diluted, diluted_shares, total_assets, current_assets, total_liabilities, current_liabilities, stockholders_equity, cash, long_term_debt, operating_cash_flow_ytd, capex_ytd, dividends_paid_ytd, free_cash_flow_ytd, gross_margin, net_margin

ticker.description: Stock ticker (e.g. AAPL). Or pass "" and use cik

name: financials_as_of
title: Financials as known on a date
